Soak yourself into ultimate unregulated freedom a haven of natural serenity in which to reconnect with the rhythms of the earth. BABA Ecolodge comprises 27 traditional villas, which are sprinkled along the shoreline with a sheltered bay, and a beautiful and deserted 12-kilometre beach. The simple island life with feet in the sand under a coconut tree.
The Baba Family
Environment​​
ลอดจ์
Have you ever had 12 kilometres of beach, just for you and the ones you love? Simple luxury meets eco-friendly experiences bound in nature. Nestled within lush tropical jungle and coconut trees on an unspoiled island with one of the last undiscovered beaches in Thailand. Immerse yourself into a life of slow living – a place where time is defined by the shadows, the sun and the sea.
Join us in our tropical gem that offers unparalleled natural diversity;
Take in the breathtaking view of an endless unspoiled beachscape, venture the depth of the mangrove by kayak, enjoy wine-sundowners on the savannah, paddle your way to small islands, explore the world under the surface, a trek he untouched rainforest, or simply daze in the protected bay.
Getting there
Access to BABA ecolodge is from either Ranong or Phuket. Ranong is the closest airport with several flights a day from Don Mueang Airport. More frequent flights between both Bangkok airports and Phuket. The resort can help to arrange transportation from either Phuket Airport or Ranong Airport at additional cost. Please make sure to not land later then 11am at either Airport in order to ensure to travel to Baba Ecolodge the same day. Please make sure to book your long tail boat (THB 2,200 one way per trip) one day prior to your arrival (email [email protected] ).
Option 1
Bangkok-Ranong 1.5 Hrs
Ranong-Kuraburi 2.20Hrs
Kuraburi-Ko Phra Thong 1.20 Hr
Option 2
Bangkok-Phuket 1.5 Hr
Phuket-Kuraburi 3 Hrs
Kuraburi-Ko Phra Thong 1.20 Hr
Villas
วิลล่า
Each of our spacious 27 bespoke wooden villas has been created in harmony with the natural features seamlessly blending into the surrounding environment. All the villas offer private gardens and elevated wooden decks for relaxation, either hidden under the lush tropical canopy or directly facing the calm Andaman Sea.
All villas are unique and designed for their very own purpose; a secluded and romantic villa for two a perfect hideaway, or for a tropical getaway with space for the entire family.
Dining
อาหาร
Dining and locally sourced food is a special highlight of Lodge life. Our kitchen is centred around the use of fresh seasonal ingredients straight from the daily market and produce from neighbouring village farmers, our organic garden featuring homegrown herbs and vegetables, and what nature grants from the sea in front of the lodge.
Prepare to Indulge yourself in our tasty authentic kitchen and choose from a variety of classics and daily specials prepared by our head chef and dictated by what the season suggests.
Wellness
สุขภาพ
Nurture your soul with revitalising treatments with first-class tropical massage and spa treatments in our dedicated Jungle Spa Sala. Welcome the morning breeze with Hatha and dynamic vinyasa-flow yoga from the yoga sala in the tranquil bay. At sunset, you can start your evening with a holistic treat for the mind with calm afternoon yoga and sessions with meditation and Pranayama.
Exploring beyond BABA
BABA is not just a brilliant stand alone destination. Whether you wish to discover more of Thailand or venture into other areas of South East Asia, BABA Ecolodge is an ideal hub for exploring the magic of the region.
As we partner up with Secret Retreats ( www.secret-retreats.com )  which is a curated selection of boutique, hotels, resorts, boats and yachts around Asia. Likeminded places with the same values and approach as we have at BABA.
Combine places in Cambodia, Laos and Vietnam, go exploring in the Indonesian waters or the jungle of Malaysia, or combine a stay at BABA with other small privately owned properties in the south of Thailand, or visit a different Bangkok or Isaan in the east of the country.
The opportunities are infinite, and we feel that more and more of our guests are showing interest for more adventurous experiences away from the mainstream tourist route, but not least looking for places with a strong sense of local presence, focus on authenticity and and nature based sustainable tourism.
Thats our aim and we have partnered up with a travel agency named Journeys Intent, dedicated to that exact type of travel. All tailormade, all with the focus on small over big and local over global.
Journeys Intent. A company deeply specialized in true experiences in Asia through decades, can help you go beyond BABA and the a real feel of this magic continent. Find inspiration here here www.journeysintent.com  or contact them on [email protected]

FAQ - BABA Ecolodge
Skip to content
Booking + Prices
When are you open?
We are generally opened between November 1st and June 30th,which corresponds to the dry season in Southern Thailand.
Is there a service charge?
We no longer separately charge the 10% service and 7% tax standard in Thailand. The prices we quote are fully inclusive, including the standard 7% VAT charge and our 10% service charge.
The 10% service charge included in our prices is shared equally between non-management staff in a bi-annual bonus instead of tips.
What is your tipping policy?
If you wish to reward a specific member of staff, then that is your personal decision. We would appreciate if you would leave a written recommendation if someone has been especially helpful.
What is your cancellation policy?
We strongly recommend that you purchase travel insurance in the event you must cancel.
Accommodation
Cancellations made 30 days in advance of the booked check-in date are cancelled without charge but minus any bank charges or fees. For cancellations made within 15 days of the booked check-in date 50% of the total booked stay will be refunded. For cancellations made within 24 hours of the booked check-in date, and no-shows, 100% of the total booked stay will be charged.
Cancellation within 24 hours or less prior to arrival or no show – No refund Where a booking is shortened the above policy applies. No refunds at the resort for accommodation after check in
Food + transportation
100% refund at all times. No refunds at the resort for food, pre-paid transport or tours and activities.
All cancellations must be made in writing to [email protected]
Check in + check out
Check in: 2.00pm Check out: 12.00 noon
Late arrival charge after 6pm at the resort: 1,000 THB for 4×4 vehicle transfer across the island (local boatmen will not cross the pass between Ko Ra and Ko Phra Thong after 6pm)
Late check out charge 300 THB/hour. Check out after 5pm charge: 1 night rate applies.
Access to BABA Ecolodge is from either Ranong or Phuket. Ranong is the closest airport with several Nok Air flights a day from Don Mueang Airport and even more frequent flights with a variety of carriers between both Bangkok airports and Phuket.
The Villas
Why are all the houses at BABA Ecolodge different?
All the houses at the lodge are privately owned. Each is as unique as its owner, and is a special place to enjoy the island’s beauty and tranquility.
Which houses are best for families with young children?
Baan Jai Yen
Baan Metha
Where can I find a resort map of the house locations?
Click  here to see a map of the BABA Ecolodge
How to get there
Can i get to the island on my own?
Because Kuraburi Pier is not a main passenger pier, we strongly suggest you book your long tail boat with us in advance.
Arriving alone at the pier, your chance of finding someone willing to take you to Kho Phra Thong is very slim. Most of the boat drivers you will find there are fishermen who don’t speak English. You might eventually find a fisherman ready to take you to the island, but they will only take you to Ta Pae Yoi village which is located on the East coast. From there you will have to find a car to take you to the resort, which is located 30mn drive away on the West coast. Failing that, you will need to call us and we will have to send a car to pick you up at the village. The trip will be much longer and more expensive.
On what island is BABA Ecolodge?
Ko Phra Thong
How do i get to Ko Phra Thong?
Most of our guests fly from Bangkok to either Phuket or Ranong. We recommend Ranong as the best option, closer and easier to negotiate than Phuket. Ranong is just over one hour by car from Kuraburi pier, compared to 2 ½ hours drive from Phuket. Nok Air operates two daily flights between Bangkok Don Mueang and Ranong. The boat transfer from Kuraburi pier to the island takes 90mn.
Can i get to BABA Ecolodge without taking a private transfer?
There are three options, you can either: 1. drive yourselves to Kuraburi Pier; 2. make use of our transfer option, in which case we meet you at the airport and drive you to Kuraburi pier; 3. use local bus services – there are many buses running north and south along the Andaman coast that pass through the town of Kuraburi. From there we can drive you to the pier. For more information, please contact
r eservation @babaecolodge.com
What airlines fly to Ranong from Bangkok?
Nok Air flies twice a day between Bangkok and Ranong.
What is your latest pick up time from Phuket International Airport to arrive at BABA Ecolodge on the same day?
Normally, our latest pickup in Phuket is 11:00 (11:30am). For more information, please get in touch. We can pick you up from Ranong until 13.00 (1:00pm).
What is the earliest i should arrange onward flights from Ranong or Phuket international airport after checking out?
Ideally after 11.30 (11.30am)
How long does it take to get from phuket international airport to BABA Ecolodge?
4 – 4.5 hours (2.5 hours by taxi and 90mn by long tail boat)
Does your private transfer car have a child’s seat?
We use local people from Kuraburi town for our transfers to Ranong and Phuket. Please let us know in advance if you would like a car that has a child seat and we will provide one.
